basis: Completed physical GPU 4 benchmark, 16 real concurrent full-budget teachers
planning_range_basis: 15–30% engineering allowance rounded upward, not a confidence interval
conditions: Five exclusive identical GPUs with matching host resources and similar object difficulty.
Same fixed per-teacher 30-rollout budget and PPO KL early-stop rule.
Five-GPU concurrency and all 3000 objects were not measured.
Excludes additional quality screening, retries, student distillation and independent closed-loop testing.
Planning range is a rounded engineering allowance, not a statistical confidence interval.
Completed training does not imply passing controller-quality requirements.
